description: This file defines the LeaveAllocation class and related functions for managing employee leave allocations, including validation, ledger entry creation, and carry-forward logic within the ERPNext HR module.

classes.name: OverlapError
classes.description: Custom validation error for overlapping leave allocations

classes.name: BackDatedAllocationError
classes.description: Custom validation error for backdated leave allocations

classes.name: OverAllocationError
classes.description: Custom validation error for over-allocating leaves

classes.name: LessAllocationError
classes.description: Custom validation error for insufficient leave allocation

classes.name: ValueMultiplierError
classes.description: Custom validation error related to value multipliers

classes.name: LeaveAllocation
classes.description: Main class managing leave allocation logic, validation, and ledger entries

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates leave allocation details including period, overlap, backdating, and total leaves

methods.name: validate_leave_allocation_days
methods.description: Checks if total allocated leaves exceed maximum allowed for the leave type

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Creates ledger entry and handles carry forward expiration on submission

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Reverses ledger entries and updates leave policy assignments on cancellation

methods.name: on_update_after_submit
methods.description: Validates and updates ledger entries after submission if leave allocation changes

methods.name: get_existing_leave_count
methods.description: Calculates existing leaves from ledger entries

methods.name: validate_against_leave_applications
methods.description: Ensures allocated leaves are not less than approved leaves

methods.name: update_leave_policy_assignments_when_no_allocations_left
methods.description: Resets leave policy assignment if no allocations remain

methods.name: validate_period
methods.description: Checks that the end date is not before the start date

methods.name: validate_lwp
methods.description: Prevents allocation of leave without pay

methods.name: validate_allocation_overlap
methods.description: Detects overlapping leave allocations for the same employee and leave type

methods.name: validate_back_dated_allocation
methods.description: Prevents backdated allocations if future allocations exist

methods.name: set_total_leaves_allocated
methods.description: Calculates total leaves including carry forward and enforces maximum limits

methods.name: limit_carry_forward_based_on_max_allowed_leaves
methods.description: Restricts carry forward based on maximum allowed leaves

methods.name: set_carry_forwarded_leaves_in_previous_allocation
methods.description: Updates previous allocation with carry forwarded leaves

methods.name: validate_total_leaves_allocated
methods.description: Ensures total allocated leaves do not exceed days in the period

methods.name: create_leave_ledger_entry
methods.description: Creates ledger entries for leaves, including carry forward and new allocation
